name: AgriMind
tagline: A sensor robot and media pipelines monitor farm zones for problems, water loss and carbon impact.
problem: Agriculture loses value to problems detected too late.
solution: A field robot streams temperature, moisture, air-quality and light readings to a dashboard; video and photo pipelines on TwelveLabs and Cloudinary flag equipment failures and risks; chat agents answer questions.
demo_moment: Team-described: live sensor readings from the robot and an annotated farm photo.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Combines a physical sensor robot with several sponsor platforms.

lessons: A physical sensor feed makes a dashboard demo real.
